significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish that, holding the target and raw prompt length fixed, “benign context-complexity” monotonically raises a pre-generation difficulty representation and wasted reasoning tokens, while “resetting that difficulty representation cancels the tax at equal accuracy”; this combines a form-(iii) relation among independently measurable quantities with a form-(ii) causal mechanism. It would establish both a deployment-shaped behavioral phenomenon and a mechanism, fixing predictions about compute under increasingly complex irrelevant context and challenging the clean-prompt assumption behind adaptive-compute approaches such as difficulty-based test-time scaling; it is more constraining than the topic-median probe-and-steer hypothesis because it distinguishes complexity from length and couples context complexity, decoded difficulty, and compute. The branches are determinate and informative: failure after length control rules out complexity contamination in favor of a raw-length account, while successful behavioral inflation but failed patching rules out the difficulty representation as its causal mediator. Topic-substitution check: replacing these specific relations with only “efficient reasoning from a mechanistic interpretability perspective” would not justify this score, so the rating reflects the claim rather than the topic.

reach.justification: The named handles are “prompt sanitation” and an “inference-time difficulty-reset controller,” with the latter acting ex ante at problem onset before wasteful generation, leaving an action window for RAG and chat systems rather than merely explaining completed traces. The conclusion is asserted across several reasoning-model scales, task classes, and “realistic RAG-retrieved irrelevant passages”; after model-specific re-extraction, its monotonic complexity-to-difficulty-to-token relation predicts what should recur, rather than supplying only an unconstrained search procedure. Downstream users include practitioners operating RAG systems and chat assistants and benchmark designers estimating deployed compute, although the claim does not yet license a model-independent numerical threshold or broad design law beyond text reasoning systems. Topic-substitution check: the generic efficient-reasoning topic supplies neither this ex-ante controller nor the transferable contamination relation, so the above-median reach comes from the claim’s specific handoff.
